quote: In addition, our agreements with some of our distribution partners are not exclusive, meaning that they have the right to shift some or all of the search traffic that they send to us to our competitors.
why: 契約は not exclusive で traffic を competitors へ shift できると明記。顧客側の摩擦の機構は無い

quote: While this is a highly competitive market, our installed base of control units, with hundreds of custom designed systems supports customers in the industrial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) market, as well as in the municipal services and energy processing markets, including petrochemicals, power generation, mining, and transportation.
why: competitive market の中で installed base と custom designed systems を名指し＝設置基盤

quote: Restaurants that use our ERB pay us a one-time installation fee for onsite installation and training, a monthly subscription fee for the use of our software and hardware and a fee for each restaurant guest seated through online reservations, as applicable.
why: 顧客が installation and training を負担し、据え付けた software and hardware に課金が乗る＝設置基盤

quote: The television broadcast environment is highly competitive.
why: highly competitive という一般的な競争記述のみ。乗り換え費用の機構は本文に無い

quote: Our clients can generally terminate our advisory agreements or reduce assets managed upon short notice and for any reason, and there can be no assurance that our agreements with respect to these relationships will remain in place.
why: 顧客は short notice かつ for any reason で terminate できると明記。摩擦の機構が無い

quote: Certain of our contracts also permit the customer to terminate the contract early by giving notice; in most circumstances this requires the payment of an early termination fee by the customer.
why: 期間契約を途中で抜けるには early termination fee by the customer が要ると断定＝顧客が負う購買義務

quote: Raymarine’s OEM customers have typically built up important embedded technical product fitting and integration knowledge over a period of time.
why: OEM customers が integration knowledge を長年蓄積と明記＝顧客側の工程への組込。再認定の断定は無い

quote: The Company receives gas revenues by selling gas directly to customers at approved rates or by transporting gas through its pipelines at approved rates to customers that have purchased gas directly from other producers, brokers, or marketers.
why: 他社から gas を買った customers にも its pipelines で輸送すると明記＝配管による物理的固着

quote: The lime industry is highly regionalized and competitive, with quality, price, ability to meet customer demands and specifications, proximity to customers, personal relationships and timeliness of deliveries being the prime competitive factors.
why: highly regionalized and competitive で price 等が競争要因という一般記述。乗り換え費用の機構は無い

quote: We compete on the basis of the quality of the patient services we provide, the results that we achieve for our patients and the prices we charge for our services.
why: quality・results・prices で compete するという一般的な競争記述のみ。患者や支払者が乗り換える費用の機構は無い

quote: Individual franchise agreements govern the operation of each restaurant opened and have a 20-year term with two renewal options each for additional 10-year terms if certain conditions are met.
why: franchise agreements は 20-year term＝加盟店が負う複数年の義務。主力の来店客には摩擦の機構なし

quote: Typically, our residents can leave after the end of a one-year lease term.
why: residents can leave と one-year lease term を明記。入居者は1年で離れられ、摩擦の機構が無い
